title: Doğadaki Sağlık 1-2
author: Ayhan Ercan
description: The Healing Power of Nature series is a comprehensive reference work that brings together the traditional use of medicinal and aromatic plants in folk medicine with modern scientific knowledge. Drawing on more than forty years of professional experience, herbal medicine specialist Ayhan Ercan offers a systematic guide to the correct identification, safe use, dosage, and home-based preparation of herbal remedies. The first volume focuses on core medicinal plants used for common ailments, detailing traditional preparation methods such as teas, tinctures, pastes, poultices, and steam applications.
english_title: The Healing Power of Nature: Medicinal Plants and Home Remedies Vol.1&2
